title: Implement Invoice Management module and add shared-session functionality (Data Lake, Tile, Invoice Management)
head: Rajan_AI_VAT_automation
body:
## Summary
- Implement Invoice Management (e-Invoice) UI/UX automation: 10 smoke scenarios, refreshed page object, and step definitions
- Roll out a single shared authenticated session (get_page override) across Data Lake IP, Tile, and Invoice Management
- Rename Tile feature/steps (DTAI_Tile -> Vat_tile) and update supporting modules and common library
- Add reconciliation page object/step defs and reorganize Belgium/France/Poland test data
- Scrub config.ini.example back to placeholders (QA + UAT sections)
